meta.description: Fantasy baseball scouting TUI application for the SBA (Strat-o-Matic Baseball Association) league

categories.critical: Must fix immediately - blocks core functionality

tasks.name: Dashboard Screen
tasks.description: Main dashboard showing roster summary (Majors/Minors/IL counts), sWAR usage, and quick navigation buttons
tasks.notes: Completed - shows roster counts and sWAR from settings

tasks.name: Roster Screen
tasks.description: Full roster view with tabbed display (Majors/Minors/IL), separate DataTables for batters and pitchers with ratings and stats
tasks.notes: Completed - batters show vL/vR/Ovr/Defense, pitchers show vL/vR/Ovr/S/R/C endurance

tasks.name: Card Data Importer
tasks.description: Import batter and pitcher card data from BatterCalcs.csv and PitcherCalcs.csv exports, including pre-calculated ratings
tasks.notes: Completed - imports vL/vR/Total ratings directly from spreadsheet

tasks.name: API Sync
tasks.description: Sync players, teams, and transactions from Major Domo league API
tasks.notes: Completed - syncs from league API on demand

tasks.name: Matchup Scout Screen
tasks.description: Core scouting feature - analyze batter vs pitcher matchups, show expected outcomes based on handedness splits
tasks.notes: Implemented: team/pitcher selectors, matchup table with rating/tier, sort by rating/name/position, switch hitter logic (uses opposite of pitcher hand)

tasks.name: Lineup Builder Screen
tasks.description: Set batting order and defensive positions, save/load lineup configurations
tasks.notes: Implemented: dual-panel UI with available batters and lineup tables, keyboard navigation (a=add, r=remove, k/j=move up/down, p=cycle position), save/load named lineups, position eligibility suggestions

tasks.name: Transactions Screen
tasks.description: View recent transactions, track player movements, manage roster moves
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Create src/sba_scout/screens/transactions.py
2. Show recent league transactions
3. Filter by team, player, date
4. Show demotion weeks for minors players
5. Highlight players who can be promoted
tasks.notes: Transaction model already exists, needs UI

tasks.name: Depth Chart Screen (by Position)
tasks.description: View roster organized by defensive position showing depth at each spot
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Create src/sba_scout/screens/depth_chart.py
2. Show positions as columns or tabs (C, 1B, 2B, SS, 3B, LF, CF, RF, DH)
3. List eligible players at each position
4. Show defensive ratings (range, error, arm)
5. Highlight primary vs secondary positions
tasks.notes: Different from Roster screen - organized by position rather than roster status

tasks.name: Player Detail Modal
tasks.description: Click on a player row to see full card details, stats, and ratings breakdown
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Create PlayerDetailModal widget
2. Show full batter card (all vs LHP and vs RHP stats)
3. Show full pitcher card (all vs LHB and vs RHB stats)
4. Show fielding details at each position
5. Show running game stats (stealing, speed)
6. Display card image if available
tasks.notes: Should work from both Roster and Matchup screens

tasks.name: Dynamic Season Configuration
tasks.description: Remove hardcoded season 13, get current season from config or API
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Add current_season to TeamSettings in config.py
2. Update .env.example with SBA_SCOUT_TEAM__CURRENT_SEASON=13
3. Replace all hardcoded 13 with settings.team.current_season
4. Optionally: fetch current season from league API
tasks.notes: Quick fix but important for multi-season support

tasks.name: Schedule Integration
tasks.description: Show upcoming games, opponent info, and starting pitchers
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Add schedule endpoint to API client
2. Create Schedule model in database
3. Add upcoming games widget to dashboard
4. Link to Matchup Scout with opponent pre-selected
tasks.notes: Would enhance dashboard and matchup workflow

tasks.name: Rating Recalculation Engine
tasks.description: Rebuild rating calculation system for matchup analysis (was removed, needs fresh implementation)

files.issue: calc module is empty after removing ratings.py and matchup.py

tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Design new calculation approach based on matchup needs
2. Consider: should matchups combine batter vL + pitcher vRHB?
3. Implement matchup_score = f(batter_rating, pitcher_rating, handedness)
4. Add tier system (A/B/C/D/F) for quick reference
tasks.notes: Original calc was removed because roster ratings come pre-calculated from spreadsheet. Matchup calculations need different logic.

tasks.name: Keyboard Navigation Enhancement
tasks.description: Add vim-style navigation, better hotkeys, command palette
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Add j/k navigation in tables
2. Add search/filter with / key
3. Implement command palette (ctrl+p)
4. Add goto player by name
tasks.notes: TUI apps benefit greatly from keyboard-first design

tasks.name: Auto-Sync on Startup
tasks.description: Optionally sync data from API when app starts, with configurable interval

files.issue: refresh_interval setting exists but not implemented

tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Check last_sync timestamp on startup
2. If stale (> refresh_interval), trigger sync
3. Show sync status in dashboard
4. Add background sync timer (optional)
tasks.notes: refresh_interval setting already exists in config

tasks.name: Theme Support
tasks.description: Light/dark theme toggle using Textual's theming system

files.issue: theme setting exists but not implemented

tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Use Textual's built-in theme system
2. Add theme toggle hotkey (t)
3. Persist theme preference in config
tasks.notes: theme setting already exists in config

tasks.name: Export Functionality
tasks.description: Export lineups, matchup reports, or roster data to various formats
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Export lineup to clipboard (for pasting into game)
2. Export matchup report to markdown/text
3. Export roster to CSV
tasks.notes: Clipboard export would be most immediately useful

tasks.name: Draft Tools
tasks.description: Tools for evaluating players during the draft
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Player search across all teams
2. Compare players side-by-side
3. Track draft queue/watchlist
4. sWAR value analysis
tasks.notes: Would be valuable during draft season

tasks.name: Add Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create test suite for core functionality
tasks.suggestedFix:
1. Test importer with sample CSV data
2. Test database queries
3. Test API client with mocked responses
4. Test config loading
tasks.notes: Focus on data layer tests first

Light theme option for users who prefer it
